skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic issues in climate science
Understand economic and global approaches to addressing climate change
Understand and differentiate economic approaches from technological and engineering approaches to solving climate change problems

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role of Economics in Policy Making
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of economics in formulating socio-economic development policies and climate change response policies
Understand specific contents on mitigation economics and adaptation economics
Understand specific contents on mitigation and adaptation policies
Understand economic analysis tools for climate change
Apply economic analysis tools to analyze and evaluate economic and policy issues related to climate change
Demonstrate skills in collecting, synthesizing information and analyzing practical issues related to national/regional/economic sector policies
Develop awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility
